# Jayrun 0.4.0

Prepare and inspect a confirmed graph's inputs before starting an Engine. A `Submission` retains the effective bindings as the original builders change. Call `submission.arguments()` for each run, including concurrent runs. The same arguments work with a Controller's `self.runtime.submit()` under its normal authority rules. Artifact payloads stay shared by reference.

Extend an existing computation with `graph.attach()`, or join several input rows with `graph.attach_many()`. Confirm the resulting graph and use its own field handles. Graph compilation now orders artifact republication after earlier reads. Single-pass computations can complete when a known feedback mismatch would only matter on a later iteration or repeat.

When upgrading from 0.3.5, supply artifact values only at graph entries and update declaration-report consumers for `jayrun.declaration/2`. The new report represents exact numeric config defaults and effective component requirements. Editable configuration YAML distinguishes omitted values from explicit null.
